انبغيت (form VII)
# اِنْبَغَيْتُ (inbaḡaytu) /in.ba.ɣaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
# اِنْبَغَيْتَ (inbaḡayta) /in.ba.ɣaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
# اِنْبَغَيْتِ (inbaḡayti) /in.ba.ɣaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَغَى (inbaḡā)
